title: Music City Crash Pad! Mins from Downtown & Topgolf
description:
3 mins from Topgolf, 8 mins from Downtown and 3 min from Germantown. 

Perfect for big groups and families looking for a comfortable getaway. Updated kitchen fully stocked with all your cooking needs. Spacious living and dining room perfect for entertaining and making forever memories with loved ones! 

Large fenced in backyard with large deck, lounge seating and best of all downtown Skyline views!

Keyless entry!

The space
3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. Currently set up to sleep 8 but additional queen mattress available in master walk in closet if needed. 

Massive master bedroom with wet bar and on the go office space! Ensuite master bathroom with double sink, rain shower head and double shower heads.

Guest access
Plenty of free street parking right in front of the house

Other things to note
Cameras: 1 ring doorbell in front of house. 1 camera facing backyard and 1 camera facing side yard for security purposes.
